title: CV-WHSVE: An Explainable Machine-Learning Framework for PLR-Based Drug-Use Screening
description: Leakage-aware source code for preprocessing, engineered feature extraction, nested genetic-algorithm model selection, cross-validated ensemble weighting, probability calibration, repeated evaluation, and synthetic-data executability checks in the CV-WHSVE framework. Participant-level data, trained model weights, predictions, and generated scientific result files are not included.
